name: tablet
description: Bring your own endpoint tab completion and next edit prediction

commands.title: Export collected records as one file

tablet.enabled.markdownDescription: Master switch for automatic suggestions. Manual triggers still work when this is off.

tablet.collect.markdownDescription: Record every suggestion tablet serves, what the model was sent, and what you did next, as JSON lines under the extension's global storage. Nothing leaves the machine. Secrets are redacted and files that look like secrets are never recorded. Toggle it from the status bar menu, which writes this setting for the open workspace.

tablet.activeConfiguration.markdownDescription: Name of the configuration to use, from `#tablet.configurations#`. Left empty with exactly one configuration defined, that one is used. Switching from the status bar overrides this for the session without writing to settings.

tablet.languages.markdownDescription: Language identifier to enabled, with `*` as the fallback.

tablet.proseLanguages.markdownDescription: Language identifiers treated as prose. In a prose document a `next-edit` configuration asks with a smaller window, a small token budget, no formatter offer, and no cross file lookup, so the answer is a few words or one precise edit instead of a rewritten paragraph.

tablet.eagerness.markdownDescription: How soon tablet asks after you pause. `auto` follows how the last twenty suggestions went: mostly accepted shortens the delays by half, mostly rejected or typed over stretches them threefold. `#tablet.debounceMs#` and `#tablet.idleTriggerMs#` are the base values.

tablet.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Idle time before an automatic request starts.

tablet.requestTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Abort deadline for one request. A 7B next-edit model on a busy server routinely needs several seconds.

tablet.log.markdownDescription: Output channel verbosity. `info` writes one line per ask: what was sent, what came back, or why nothing was asked. Assembled prompts and replies are printed at `debug` only. An api key is never printed.

chunks.description: How many cross file chunks to hold.

scopeLines.description: How far above and below the cursor the prompt already reaches. A chunk is picked just outside that span.

tablet.ringBuffer.markdownDescription: Bounds for the cross file context ring.

tablet.configurations.markdownDescription: Named configurations. Each one holds an endpoint, a key, a model, and a prompt format. Exactly one is active at a time.

endpoint.description: Base url of an OpenAI compatible server, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1. The request goes to {endpoint}/completions.

apiKey.markdownDescription: A literal key, `os.environ/NAME` to read the environment, or `secretstorage/NAME` to read a key stored by the `tablet.setApiKey` command.

headers.markdownDescription: Extra request headers. Each value resolves the same three ways as `apiKey`.

model.description: Model name sent to the server.

format.markdownDescription: `fim` completes at the cursor. `next-edit` rewrites a window of code in the sweep layout and can propose an edit away from the cursor. `zeta` rewrites numbered blocks around the cursor in the zed zeta 2.1 layout, with the edit history as unified diffs.

template.markdownDescription: The whole prompt, with `{{placeholder}}` substitutions. For `fim`: `prefix`, `suffix`, `path`, `repo`, `context`. For `next-edit`: `path`, `file`, `context`, `changes`, `original`, `current`, `prefill`, `start`, `end`, `diagnostics`, `format`. For `zeta`: `path`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `editable`, `history`, `context`, `diagnostics`. Left unset, the default for the format is used.

chunkTemplate.markdownDescription: Rendered once per cross file chunk and joined, substituted into `{{context}}`. Placeholders: `path`, `text`.

changeTemplate.markdownDescription: Rendered once per recent change and joined. For `next-edit` it fills `{{changes}}` with placeholders `path`, `before`, `after`. For `zeta` it fills `{{history}}` with placeholders `path`, `diff`, where `diff` is a unified hunk.

cursorMarker.markdownDescription: Inserted at the cursor inside the window the model rewrites. Used by `next-edit` and `zeta`.

stop.description: Stop strings sent with the request.

contextBudget.markdownDescription: Tokens the prompt and the answer may hold together. Set it to the endpoint's context size with a little margin. Sections leave the prompt in a fixed order until it fits, and an endpoint that still refuses a prompt lowers the budget for the session.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Above zero is needed for several distinct samples.

prefixLines.description: Lines before the cursor sent as prefix. Used by fim.

suffixLines.description: Lines after the cursor sent as suffix. Used by fim.

windowLines.description: Lines of the window the model rewrites. Used by next-edit and zeta.

contextLines.description: Lines of the target file sent around the window. Used by next-edit and zeta.

crossFileCandidates.markdownDescription: How many other files to ask about when the local window comes back unchanged. Zero disables cross file suggestions. Used by `next-edit` only.

extraBody.markdownDescription: Merged into the request body verbatim. Ask for several samples here: `{"n_cmpl": 3}` on llama.cpp, `{"n": 3}` on most other servers.

diagnosticTemplate.markdownDescription: Rendered once when the file has errors or warnings, substituted into `{{diagnostics}}`. Placeholders: `path`, `text`. Used by `next-edit` and `zeta`, where it is empty by default because the model was not trained with one.

formatMarker.markdownDescription: What the model may reply with, alone, to ask for the document formatter instead of proposing an edit. Substituted into `{{formatMarker}}` in the template, so the instruction and the marker never drift apart. Set it to an empty string to drop the instruction and stop looking for it. Used by `next-edit` only.

formatTemplate.markdownDescription: The instruction telling the model it may ask for the formatter, substituted into `{{format}}`. Placeholder: `marker`. Rendered as nothing when `formatMarker` is empty. Used by `next-edit` only.

contextFiles.markdownDescription: How many recently touched files to show the model a window of, taken around the identifier your last change removed. This is what lets a rename in one file be recognised when you move to another. Zero turns it off. Used by `next-edit` and `zeta`.

tablet.idleTriggerMs.markdownDescription: How long the cursor has to rest before tablet asks for a suggestion, in milliseconds. The editor only asks by itself when the document changes, so this is what makes resting on the line you are about to fix produce a suggestion. Zero turns it off.
